1. \(|x| - |y| = 1\)
2. \(|y| - |x| = 1\)

We will consider these two cases separately.

\[ (x + 3y) - (x + y) = 3 - 1 \implies 2y = 2 \implies y = 1 \]

\[ x + 1 = 1 \implies x = 0 \]

So, one solution is \((x, y) = (0, 1)\).

\[

\[
